property.text: Deposit requests must be parsed from block output logs, not from system transactions. process_general_purpose_requests (SG-012) must derive deposit requests from log entries via parse_deposit_requests.

reachability.notes: If the log parsing is incorrect (wrong contract address, wrong ABI decoding), fraudulent deposit requests could be injected or legitimate deposits could be missed.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect deposit parsing could inject fraudulent validator deposits or miss legitimate ones, affecting consensus layer validator set.
property.bug_bounty_notes: PoC must demonstrate fraudulent deposit requests injected via crafted log entries, or missing legitimate deposits.

property.text: Withdrawal and consolidation requests must come from checked system transactions that must succeed. process_general_purpose_requests (SG-012) must call process_checked_system_transaction for withdrawal and consolidation request contracts.

reachability.notes: If the checked variant is replaced with unchecked, system contract failures would be silently ignored, producing incorrect request data. An attacker could manipulate system contract state to cause failures.

property.severity_justification: If system contract calls fail silently, withdrawal and consolidation requests are lost or corrupted, affecting validator operations network-wide.
property.bug_bounty_notes: PoC must demonstrate a system contract failure that is not caught, leading to incorrect request data in the block.

property.text: Block number must be >= 1. validate_header (SG-005) must reject blocks with header.number < 1 (genesis block is 0).

reachability.notes: A peer sends a block with number 0. If accepted, it could corrupt chain state or trigger genesis-specific code paths.

property.severity_justification: Accepting a block with number 0 could trigger unexpected code paths but is caught by the very first validation check.
property.bug_bounty_notes: PoC must demonstrate a block with number < 1 being accepted by a client.

property.text: Block timestamps must be strictly increasing. validate_header (SG-005) must enforce: header.timestamp > parent_header.timestamp.

reachability.notes: A proposer sets timestamp <= parent timestamp. If accepted, time-dependent operations (e.g., TIMESTAMP opcode, time-locked contracts) could behave incorrectly.

property.severity_justification: Non-increasing timestamps break time-dependent protocol assumptions and smart contract behavior.
property.bug_bounty_notes: PoC must demonstrate a block with non-increasing timestamp being accepted.

property.text: Block numbers must be sequential. validate_header (SG-005) must enforce: header.number == parent_header.number + 1.

reachability.notes: A proposer sends a block with a gap or duplicate number. If accepted, chain continuity is broken.

property.severity_justification: Non-sequential block numbers break chain continuity and could enable block number reuse attacks.
property.bug_bounty_notes: PoC must demonstrate a block with non-sequential number being accepted.

property.text: Extra data must be limited to 32 bytes. validate_header (SG-005) must enforce: len(header.extra_data) <= 32.

reachability.notes: A proposer includes excessive extra data. Unbounded extra data could be used for block size inflation.

property.severity_justification: Excess extra data causes minor block inflation but is bounded by the RLP size limit.

property.text: Parent hash must cryptographically match parent header. validate_header (SG-005) must enforce: header.parent_hash == keccak256(rlp.encode(parent_header)).

reachability.notes: An attacker creates a block with a parent_hash that does not match the actual parent header hash. If accepted, chain reorganization or fork attacks become possible.

property.severity_justification: Parent hash mismatch enables chain reorganization attacks, undermining the fundamental chain integrity.
property.bug_bounty_notes: PoC must demonstrate a block accepted with parent_hash != keccak256(rlp.encode(parent_header)).

property.text: Excess blob gas must match calculation from parent. validate_header (SG-005) must enforce: header.excess_blob_gas == calculate_excess_blob_gas(parent_header).

reachability.notes: A proposer sets incorrect excess_blob_gas. If the calculation has an edge case (e.g., underflow when target_blob_gas > parent_blob_gas_used), clients may diverge.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect excess blob gas affects blob fee calculations, potentially causing consensus splits between clients with different arithmetic handling.
property.bug_bounty_notes: PoC must demonstrate a block accepted with incorrect excess_blob_gas or demonstrate arithmetic edge case causing divergence.

property.text: Gas used must not exceed gas limit. validate_header (SG-005) must enforce: header.gas_used <= header.gas_limit.

reachability.notes: A proposer sets gas_used > gas_limit in the header. If accepted, blocks can exceed their declared capacity.

property.severity_justification: Gas used > gas limit breaks the gas accounting model and could cause consensus failure on the gas_used root check.
property.bug_bounty_notes: PoC must demonstrate a block accepted with gas_used > gas_limit.

property.text: Gas limit change must be bounded by parent_gas_limit // GAS_LIMIT_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR. check_gas_limit (SG-015) must enforce: abs(gas_limit - parent_gas_limit) < parent_gas_limit // 1024.

reachability.notes: A proposer adjusts gas limit beyond bounds. If the check fails, rapid gas limit changes could destabilize the network.

property.severity_justification: Even if the check is bypassed for a single block, the impact is limited. Exploitation requires sustained proposer control.
